# Need & Know

## Project
Need & Know is a sustainability knowledge-to-action platform that helps organisations describe real challenges and discover relevant research, expertise, projects, and practitioners.

## Problem it solves
The knowledge and expertise already exist, but they are difficult to find when an NGO, municipality, community group, or project team needs practical help. Need & Know connects the need with the right knowledge and people, with a clear explanation of why the connection matters.

## How it works
- People describe a real challenge in plain language.
- The platform structures the need: theme, location, type of support needed, and time frame.
- AI helps suggest relevant research, expertise, and projects.
- A human broker reviews suggestions before any introduction is made.
- The platform measures whether the connection led to a useful conversation.

## Relationship to SCC
The Sustainability Collaboration Center (SCC) is the independent nonprofit umbrella behind Need & Know. SCC is being set up as a Swiss nonprofit association and exists to help sustainability knowledge turn into action faster.

## Focus areas
- climate adaptation
- sustainability knowledge mobilisation
- research-to-practice collaboration
- NGO and practitioner support
- human-reviewed introductions

## Geographic scope
Need & Know is beginning in Suisse romande, with a pilot focus on climate adaptation in Switzerland.

## Audience
- NGOs and practitioners
- researchers and universities
- funders and foundations
- sustainability-focused organisations

## Trust and governance
Need & Know is designed to be independent, transparent, and human-led. Suggestions are never sent automatically, and the platform is not intended to certify organisations or rank people without review.
